glosses: terza persona singolare dell'indicativo presente di opinare
seconda persona singolare dell'imperativo di opinare
To express an opinion; to state as an opinion; to suppose, consider (that).

examples.text: I opined that matters would soon become considerably worse.
"Your decisions," she opined, "have been unfailingly disastrous for this company."

glosses: To give one's formal opinion (on or upon something).

examples.text: I had to opine on the situation because I thought a different perspective was in order.

glosses: to suppose, consider as correct, or entertain, an opinion.

examples.text: Do you, Maister Francis, opine that ye will re-establish your father's credit by cutting your kinsman's thrapple, or getting your ain sneckit instead thereof in the College-yards of Glasgow?
This, I opine, is a correct and fair statement of the case.
